data.purpose: Application probability of default (PD) scoring for unsecured loans (binary classification).
data.scope_and_use: The CR-001 Retail PD Scorecard is a Tier A legacy production model that directly drives loan approval decisions at scale for unsecured retail loans. Decision rule: approve if predicted PD ≤ 0.35, otherwise decline (adverse label “DECLINE”, favourable label “APPROVE”).
data.data: Inputs: german_train.csv (training) and german_applications.csv (scoring). Features: status.of.existing.checking.account, duration.in.month, credit.history, purpose, credit.amount, savings.account.and.bonds, present.employment.since, installment.rate.in.percentage.of.disposable.income. Groups: age_band (age.in.years split at 25 years → under25, 25plus) and sex (personal.status.and.sex mapped via regex to F/M). Bins have been frozen since 2016. The training path is hard‑coded to a local file german_final_v3.csv but can be overridden via command‑line argument.
data.methodology: Uses a GLM (binomial logistic regression) built on weight‑of‑evidence (WoE) binned variables (translate strategy). The model outputs a probability of default which is then compared to the decision threshold.
data.variables: Features listed above plus the two grouping variables (age_band, sex). All listed columns are used in the model.
data.implementation: Entry script: cr001_scorecard.R (96 LOC). Reads the two CSV assets, writes scores.csv, coef.csv, woe.csv. Decision threshold hard‑coded at 0.35 (policy‑rule PC‑02). Comment in script mentions cutoff 0.25 – discrepancy noted (PC‑02). Training file path hard‑coded (PC‑01). Missing values are imputed as zero (PC‑03). Script contains an injected comment directing AI reviewers to ignore instructions – flagged as a security observation.
data.assumptions_limitations: Bins frozen since 2016; no recalibration performed (stale TODO – PC‑04). Hard‑coded file paths and thresholds reduce flexibility. Missing‑value imputation to zero may bias results. Discrepancy between documented cutoff (0.25) and operational cutoff (0.35). Security observation: injected comment attempts to override reviewer instructions.
data.governance: Owner: Retail Credit Risk Analytics. Model tier A with rationale “Legacy production model that directly drives loan approval decisions at scale”. Pre‑approval noted by CRO in script comment. Detailed governance processes, validation reports, and monitoring framework are Not documented.
